title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Finance Note: The Over-Cap Amount of a Not-Found Line
content:
**Over-cap amount of a not-found line on Cartwise Grocery Orders.** The over-cap claim value is the sum of the amounts billed on the line recorded as not found. The over-cap amount is the over-cap claim value less the missing refund standing on the order, never below zero, rounded to the cent.

### Terms used in this note

- **Line recorded as not found** — an item line of the order that carries a billed line charge although the shopper's substitution decision for it records the product as not found (refunded).
- **Over-cap claim value** — the total of the amounts on that line's billed item line charge entries, in dollars.
- **Missing refund standing on the order** — the total of every item refund entry on the order whose refund reason is missing, as the order entries show it at the moment of the calculation.
- **Over-cap amount** — the claim value less that missing refund total; where the missing refunds equal or exceed the claim value the amount is zero. The result is rounded to the cent, half up.

### Worked through (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical Standard Delivery order has one line recorded as not found, billed for 3 units at 12.50 each, so its billed line charges total 37.50. The order entries show one missing refund of 21.40.

| Quantity | Figure |
|---|---|
| Over-cap claim value (billed charges on the not-found line) | 37.50 |
| Missing refund standing on the order | 21.40 |
| Over-cap amount: 37.50 less 21.40, rounded to the cent | 16.10 |

### Both sides of the floor (hypothetical figures)

| Claim value | Missing refund standing | Over-cap amount |
|---|---|---|
| 37.50 | 37.49 | 0.01 |
| 37.50 | 37.50 | 0.00 |
| 37.50 | 40.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |

The missing refund taken off is the order's whole missing-refund total, not only the refunds that name the not-found line.
